name: avunu/gutenberg-downgrade-test-tools
description: Test runners and static analysers for gutenberg-downgrade. Deliberately separate from the plugin's own composer.json: composition-c4's fetchComposerDeps clones lock.packages ++ lock.packages-dev at eval time with allRefs=true, so anything added to the root manifest is paid for on every `nix build .#zip`. php-codesniffer is locked here. phpstan is not: it is dist-only, and composition-c4 refuses a lock with a dist-only package, so it is locked in tests/static-analysis, which nix does not read.
